# T-1: Journal finalize checkpoints

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Record and validate the finalize transaction checkpoint for every destructive lifecycle boundary.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Checkpoint persistence precedes each destructive transition.
- At most one retry per invocation resumes only an unfinished recorded checkpoint.
- Persistence failure blocks later cleanup transitions.

## Implementation Notes
Use dedicated transaction and checkpoint value classes with invariant checks.

## Test Strategy
Unit fault-matrix tests cover R1 checkpoint persistence and replay.
